localFacts.fact: Canon España lists the PowerShot V1 at 426 g, tripod socket 1/4 (ISO 1222), and 'empuñadura para trípode HG-100TBR/HG-200TBR' among its accessories.
Iberia allows one cabin bag up to 10 kg with max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm; the Peak Design Travel Tripod folds to 39 cm and fits by length.
Ryanair includes a small bag of 40 x 30 x 20 cm under the seat in every fare; the four minis fold to 18,5-22 cm.
Sagrada Família normativa: photos or videos with a tripod are not allowed inside the site, except for people or companies accredited beforehand.
Alhambra (Patronato): photos only without flash and without tripod, monopod or any other camera stabilising element, which also rules out a grip used as a stand.
Spanish terms: empuñadura para trípode, minitrípode / trípode de mesa, rótula de bola, columna central, rosca de 1/4"; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.

localPainPoints.pain: The V1's ports sit on the grip side, which gets in the way handheld.
localPainPoints.fix: A small tripod or a grip (HG-100TBR, MT-16) solves it, as MPB's Spanish V1 review says; run USB-C power while it stands.

quotes.text: Usar un trípode pequeño o una empuñadura puede solucionar ese problema

localPainPoints.pain: Spare batteries are needed on long travel days, and the battery door is under the tripod.
localPainPoints.fix: English post: charge or swap first, screw a mini straight into the socket and unscrew it to swap, or use USB-C PD power for long takes.

quotes.text: sigo recomendando encarecidamente llevar una o dos baterías de repuesto

localPainPoints.pain: Wanting a tripod that fits a very small backpack.
localPainPoints.fix: All four minis fold to 18,5-22 cm, inside Ryanair's 40 x 30 x 20 cm small bag.

Ryanair small bag and Iberia cabin-bag sizes against each pick's folded length.
Sagrada Família and Alhambra tripod/stabiliser bans (the grip counts as a stabiliser at the Alhambra).
